title: Compute Labs
sources: Roles and bios from the public Compute Labs about page (computelabs.ai/en/about); vibe notes from the public team photos.

common.look: humble everyday-fantasy job tied to the person's traits: plain cloth or leather, muted silver/grey, no magic effects

uncommon.look: trained adventurer: practical gear with green accents, a first hint of skill or a small familiar, no big effects

rare.look: seasoned class hero: fitted armour or robes with teal accents, one signature item, faint teal glow

epic.look: elite arcane form: ornate gear, visible violet magic (runes, glowing eyes or aura), dramatic lighting

legendary.look: the single mythic ascended form: gold and white regalia, crown/halo/wings or cosmic elements, radiant golden aura; the most awe-inspiring card of this person

slots.bio: Founder & CEO; launched Compute Labs in 2024 around a GPU real-world-asset vision; gaming-industry background (Delysium, rct.AI, Xsolla); UCLA and Caltech.
slots.vibe: composed, sharp and quietly determined; neat hair, glasses, sharp suit
